# FOLTIO — AI film studio

> FOLTIO is an AI film studio with a browser-based multitrack video editor, generative media tools and an agent-native filmmaking workflow. Use the managed product at https://folt.io/ or self-host the open-source core from https://github.com/foltio/foltio.

FOLTIO helps creators move from raw footage or an idea to a finished video in one workspace: plan the story, create storyboards, generate and compare shots with sound, upload existing media, edit picture and sound on a real timeline, add dialogue, music, captions and effects, then render the final cut.

## Key facts

- The built-in filmmaking and editing agent is called Hermes.
- Hermes can work across story development, the production board, generated media and the edit timeline.
- FOLTIO can generate images, video, voice and music and can also edit user-uploaded footage.
- The open-source edition includes the browser editor, media pipeline, rendering engine and a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for compatible AI agents.
- Projects can be kept private or shared publicly. A public project can be watched and cloned into another user's workspace.
- New accounts receive 500 credits and do not need a card.
- AI generation and Hermes agent work use credits. The exact generation price is shown before it runs.
- Editing, uploads and rendering are free.
- The base rate is 100 credits per US dollar; plans and larger top-ups include bonus credits.
